title: COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

Union
Y_003892

43. INSTALL UNION AND ELBOW
(a) Coat the new O-rings with ATF and install them to union and elbow.
(b) Install the front union.
Torque: 29 N·m (300 kgf·cm, 22 ft·lbf)
(c) Install the rear union.
Torque: 29 N·m (300 kgf·cm, 22 ft·lbf)

Y_003891

44. SUPRA, T100
INSTALL A/T OIL TEMPERATURE SENSOR
(a) Coat new O-ring with ATF and install it to the oil temperature sensor.
(b) Install the sensor.
Torque: 29 N·m (300 kgf·cm, 22 ft·lbf)

Y_003890

45. INSTALL PARK/NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH
(a) Install the park/neutral position switch onto the manual valve lever shaft and temporarily tighten the adjusting bolt.
(b) Install the grommet and a new lock washer. Install and torque the nut.
Torque: 6.9 N·m (70 kgf·cm, 61 in.·lbf)

Neutral Position
AT4624

(c) Using the control shaft lever, fully turn the manual lever shaft back and return 2 notches. It is now in neutral.

Bolt
Neutral Basic Line
Groove
AT4369

(d) Align the neutral basic line and the switch groove, and tighten the adjusting bolt.
Torque: 13 N·m (130 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)
(e) Bend the tabs of the lock washer.
HINT: Bend at least 2 of the lock washer tabs.
